title: Pilot smoke: walk down the Sunset Sarsaparilla HQ's stairs to Allen Marks' holotape and back up

actions.text: The prize room, its corridor and stairs are navmesh 0x0010489C, which no link joins to the cell's main navmesh 0x0010AF20 (#3473); in the original a follower does not cross there either (observer check 279), a player walks the stairs. A Valuable Lesson's stage 10 is set and, as its stand-in in this chain, the corridor door 0x0010487B and the prize room door 0x00103DF6 are unlocked by script (stage 10 alone left the prize room door locked in the pilot's run, 2026-11-27).
Back up the stairs to Festus, on the main navmesh.
